basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and trader in the virtual worlds of Royale High and beyond. Based in Melbourne, Australia, I juggle between studying linguistics at university and diving into the retro gaming scene, particularly Sega CD titles. My evenings are reserved for intense trading sessions and occasional culinary poetry inspired by my love for food. Not a fan of early mornings, but often online late into the night. Single and ready to mingle, but mostly just with fellow gamers and traders.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Has a strong foundation in linguistic studies, currently pursuing a degree in the field. This academic journey has been complemented by a personal passion for retro gaming, leading to self-taught expertise in Sega CD games. The trading skills have been honed over time through active participation in Royale High Trading community.
